title: Does not work with foaming hand soap!
text:
Does not work with foaming hand soap!. [[VIDEOID:b9e4ece507942bb5d31debee1377a0b]] I ordered this automatic soap dispenser thinking that it would work for liquid foaming hand soap. The description says liquid, but isn’t specific if this means the foaming or non foaming hand soap. It will not work with foaming hand soap as shown in my video.

I tried it with traditional liquid hand soap and it works. I don’t think the sensor is super strong as sometimes you put your hand there, need to pull back, and put your hand in front of the sensor again to get the soap to come out. For the price, there are better soap dispensers out there....

It also requires 4 AA batteries, (not included).
